svg.title: Artha product architecture
svg.desc: Product architecture showing review-before-save capture, read-only Ask Artha, the provider-neutral LLM boundary, and application and ledger authority.

g.text: Two AI-assisted journeys; application code remains authoritative and every ledger write requires a person.
A sentence becomes ledger truth only after review and explicit confirmation
Read-only answers use canonical facts and application-owned generative UI
Person decides writes • FastAPI owns rules • Postgres + RLS own ledger truth • LLM has no ledger credentials
AI interprets. Artha validates. You decide.
Blue app • amber AI • coral human checkpoint • green ledger/security
